annotations.text:
Light-first refresh, matched to the code that already exists.

Geist, 10px base radius (cards 14, controls 8), 36px control height, 24px card padding — all lifted from components/ui, not invented. The purple→pink gradient stays, but only on the wordmark; UI uses one solid accent so it can carry meaning.

Static mockups, not a clickable prototype.
Matches what is already shipped: play/pause and a scrubber, nothing else. No volume, speed, fullscreen or download.
Correct Decision is the short verdict; Explanation is the reasoning written against the referee's own answer. Both now come from /api/check-answer.
